scopeLimits: Acceptance means visual source ownership of the unchanged declared threshold components in these22tokens, not recovery of every original printed/antialiased ink pixel or original font geometry.
No glyph extents, word gaps, row medians, bits, decoded strings or format/candidate tests were computed.
No source thresholds, morphology, minimum-area filters, component splitting or clipping were introduced.
No142-row component ownership acceptance, detector repair success, measurement readiness, cipher/key negative or funding conclusion follows.
Any later source uncertainty, including underlines/strike-through elsewhere, remains outside this two-row acceptance.
